facts.claim: Mykonos Blu (Grecotel) has a 'Weddings & Vow Renewals' page on its official site, with a 'Request for weddings' enquiry option, dedicated wedding specialists, customised menus and trusted vendors. Page modified 21 October 2026.

Mykonos Blu wedding page: 'Extraordinary wedding experiences on the most exclusive beach in Greece, Psarou, with the enchanting sunset as a backdrop'. Highlights listed include 'a Cycladic settlement on the waterfront' and 103 guest rooms.

Mykonos Blu ceremony venue: The Ocean Balcony, 'accommodating up to 60 guests, perched just above the pristine beach of Psarou' with an uninterrupted sea view. After the ceremony the hotel can arrange the wedding table and party for up to 120 guests in its L'Archipel restaurant and pool area. Ceremony type (civil, Orthodox or symbolic) is not stated.

Petasos Beach Resort's official 'Plan an event in Mykonos' page says the resort 'is set on a private peninsula' with a panoramic view of the Aegean, and that its indoor and outdoor venues can contribute to 'a meeting, conference, wedding celebration, or any other type of memorable special event'. Page meta description: 'Weddings, corporate gatherings and private functions handled with care and precision.'

Petasos Beach Resort event facilities table (banquet / reception / cocktail): V.I.P. Restaurant 180 / 220 / 300; Le Club Restaurant 70 / 90 / 110; Swimming Pool 280 / 350 / 500. The page also names The Amphitheatre (no capacity given).

Myconian Ambassador (Relais & Chateaux) has an official 'Weddings & Events' page: 'Exchanging vows in a small chapel, followed by a reception on the beach or our entertainment deck'. It adds that for grand wedding banquets it recommends 'the exceptional venues of our sister hotels in Elia'. Chapel location (on site or nearby), capacity and ceremony type are not stated.

Mykonos Blu official homepage: 'Mykonos Blu, Psarou Beach. A Cycladic Icon on the most celebrated beach of the island', with Cycladic architecture, suites and villas with private pools on the Psarou waterfront, and 'The BLU emblematic cave pool'. Address in the page's structured data: Psarou Beach, Mykonos 846 00.

The former San Giorgio Mykonos web address (sangiorgio-mykonos.com) now redirects to Soho House's official page for Soho Roc House, Paraga Beach, Mykonos 846 00. The page describes 'a members' club and beachside hotel in Mykonos with 44 bedrooms'.

Soho Roc House official page: 'Open for six months of the year, the beachside outpost has 44 bedrooms, sea views and a path down to the shore, plus an outdoor gym ... and a small in-house chapel, which is available for wedding ceremonies'. Page states it 'is currently closed, reopening in spring 2027' and advises it 'is located among vibrant beach clubs, where the atmosphere is lively and the music can be energetic'. Chapel capacity, reception spaces and whether non-members can book a wedding are not stated.

Petasos Beach Resort & Spa official homepage: 'Perched on a private peninsula between Platis Gialos and Psarou', with direct beach access, a private beach called 'La Petite Psarou', and 'timeless Cycladic design with whitewashed curves, handcrafted stonework, and elegant pergolas'. Structured-data address: Platis Yialos, Mykonos 84600. Room categories include rooms, suites and villas (rooms, suites and private-pool villas); a total room count is not stated on the pages read.

Petasos Beach Resort amenities listed on its official homepage include a two-level saltwater swimming pool with waterfall, the 500 sq m Aqua Marine Spa with thalassotherapy pool, and meeting and banquet rooms. Its event page does not name ceremony types or a ceremony venue.

Myconian Ambassador official homepage: 'Set above Platis Gialos beach ... just 5km away from the vibrant energy of Mykonos Town', with neighbouring Psarou within walking distance. It lists Weddings & events among its services ('As experts in romance and discretion...') and its fine-dining restaurant Efisia. Room count is not stated on the pages read. The hotel is part of the Myconian Collection.

Kensho Psarou: no official wedding page could be read live. The likely official domain (kenshomykonos.com) returned a TLS certificate error on 2026-11-11, and the group site kenshohotels.com (read live) now presents only a Paros property, with no Mykonos hotel or wedding page. Search results for Kensho Psarou weddings were planner galleries and a 2019 press-release aggregator, which do not meet the inclusion rule. Verdict: exclude.

Myconian Collection group weddings page: 'Exchange vows in a small whitewashed chapel, followed by a reception on the beach, or in one of our fine restaurants overlooking the Aegean and Mykonos town.' It says the group assists 'in officiating ceremonies across all denominations' and has certified halal and kosher kitchens. The Horizons Ballroom (270 guests at round tables, 380 to 400 banqueting, up to 550 for cocktails) is presented alongside 'Our hotels in Elia', not at the Ambassador.

venue_verdicts.note: Meets the inclusion rule (official Soho House page says the in-house chapel is available for wedding ceremonies), but it is a members' club, closed until spring 2027, and the page warns of loud neighbouring beach clubs. Orchestrator to decide; write under its current name, Soho Roc House.

insider_details.detail: At Mykonos Blu the ceremony space and the reception space are sized differently: The Ocean Balcony holds up to 60 for the ceremony, while L'Archipel restaurant and the pool area take up to 120 for dinner and dancing, so a guest list between 61 and 120 needs a conversation with the hotel about where the vows can happen.

Petasos Beach Resort publishes the largest numbers in this batch: its pool area seats 280 at a banquet (500 for cocktails) and the V.I.P. Restaurant seats 180, which makes it the Platis Gialos option for a bigger guest list, but its event page names no ceremony spot, so ask the Wedded Advisor to confirm where the vows themselves would take place.

Myconian Ambassador is the intimate choice of the Myconian Collection: its own wedding page pairs a small chapel with a beach or deck reception and sends grand banquets to the group's Elia hotels, so couples planning a large celebration should compare it with the Elia properties rather than book it for scale.

Psarou and Platis Gialos sit side by side: Petasos describes itself as on a peninsula between the two beaches, and the Ambassador says Psarou is within walking distance, so a couple could base guests across these hotels without a long transfer between them.

Soho Roc House at Paraga says on its own page that it sits among lively beach clubs where music can be energetic, which matters for a sunset chapel ceremony; plan the ceremony time and sound expectations in writing with the Wedded Advisor before committing.
